text:
nina: Quick thread — need to finalize console observability deliverables for next milestone. Sales pressure: per-route cost, error analytics with trace links, and a low-cost tracing mode. Can we finalize owners and M1/M2 split?

patrick: Proposal: M1 = compact cost by route + error buckets + trace-index (metadata only) + trace-id links. M2 = sampling slider, per-route overrides, optional full-span ingestion.

esther: Customers consent: they need per-route cost to sign; they accept sample-based traces. They asked for 30d lookback.

cal: Runtime note: storing full spans continuously is expensive. Alternative: trace-index + on-demand full span fetch. Adds infra ticket but reduces baseline spend.

nina: Draft acceptance criteria (quick):
```
- Cost tile: per-route token_count, embedding_count, est $ cost; default windows 7d/30d; filter by model
- Error analytics: grouped by class (drop/retry/timeout), top routes, sample trace ids with one-click copy
- Trace hook: server span annotations emitted for sampled requests; trace id surfaced in error details
- Retention: trace-index 90d, full-span 7d default; cheap metric rollup path for long-term cost
- Rollout: canary to 3 pilot orgs for 7 days; telemetry cost delta <25% to proceed; rollback if error rate >1.5x
- Tests: synthetic prompt replay, cost smoke, UI drilldown acceptance
```

patrick: I'll own backend cost API and the cost tile. Creating ticket BACK-3348.

esther: I'll own UX & docs. Figma mockup: https://redwood.internal/figma/observe-mini

cal: I'll own runtime annotated spans + infra coordination; creating RUNTIME-8812 and INF-8813.

telemetry-bot: Reminder: Roadmap sync Thu 11:00 PT.

nina: Decision: ship M1 as cost tile + trace-index + error buckets + trace-id links. M2 deferred. If no objections by EOD, I'll mark roadmap commit. :rocket:

patrick: :thumbsup:

esther: :thumbsup:

cal: :thumbsup:

nina: Thanks — I'll update the roadmap doc with owners and tickets.
